answer: Weigh each identity by the conductance of its attestation neighborhood: trust edges crossing OUT to independent witnesses divided by edges kept inside. A sybil ring is a closed quartz geode, brilliant mutual praise within and almost no edge reaching the wider graph, so its conductance collapses and its reward with it. An honest node is a vertex on an open knoll, drawing edges from strangers it cannot control, and no manufactured cluster fakes that outward leakage.
